text:
emma (Support): FYI escalation from FinServe — they migrated to Dedicated yesterday and now see previously-deleted records appearing in a compliance export. customer says audit logs show KMS decrypt errors around the time of the migration. asking for timeline + temp preservation until we sort root cause.

ben (SRE): ack. can you paste the exact export request and any sample object ids or error payloads? also which account/org id?

emma (Support): account: fs-prod-22. export request sample they ran (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/exports
{
  "account_id": "fs-prod-22",
  "include_deleted": false,
  "time_range": "2026-03-15..2026-03-17"
}
```
Response they got repeatedly:
```json
{
  "status": "partial_success",
  "errors": [
    {"obj_id":"obj_9a8b7c","error":"kms:Decrypt failed","key":"alias/redwood-fs-prod-22-v2"}
  ]
}
```
They also attached CSV rows that contain tombstone markers for objects they believed were removed.

sophia (Infra): checking infra logs — I see a key rotation job for alias `alias/redwood-fs-prod-22` at 2026-03-17T02:04:58Z (rotation-job-2026-03-17-02). rotation completed but there were transient decrypt failures reported by the export workers between 02:05 and 02:12 UTC.

retention-bot: retention-policy-change detected for account fs-prod-22 — default_retention changed from `365d` -> `90d` at 2026-03-16T23:58:03Z by migration-tool v1.4.2.

raj (Legal): if the customer is asking for a preservation window, we need to mark affected objects as preserved immediately and provide a timeline for exports. do we have a rapid-preserve API we can call on their behalf?

ben (SRE): steps I need to repro + triage: 1) list one or two failing obj_ids (from their CSV) 2) exact export call (we have sample) 3) the export job id if available. meanwhile quick diagnostic you can run on the export worker: ```/usr/local/bin/export-check --job-id <JOB_ID> --show-errors``` or query logs: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND jsonPayload.account_id=\"fs-prod-22\" AND severity>=ERROR" --limit 100`

emma (Support): provided two obj ids in DM to Ben: obj_9a8b7c, obj_12d4ef. export job id: export_20260317_4129. customer is asking whether the retention policy change could have caused the tombstones to be re-materialized in the export — they think objects deleted earlier this year reappeared.

sophia (Infra): retention change alone shouldn't resurrect deleted objects, but if export workers saw Decrypt errors they may have retried and included placeholder tombstone rows. two possible paths: (A) key rotation led to decrypt failures and export fallback produced tombstone rows flagged as "deleted=false" in CSV (parsing bug), (B) migration tool incorrectly applied a shorter default retention and TTLs for a subset of buckets got updated. I'll check the migration diffs.

ben (SRE): action items: 1) I'll pull the export worker logs for export_20260317_4129 and grep for obj_9a8b7c/obj_12d4ef. 2) Sophia to confirm whether migration altered TTLs or wrote back retention metadata. 3) Emma to request the customer to pause any retention policy changes and to not run further exports until we confirm. 4) Raj to prepare hold notice template if we need to preserve objects. assigning P0.

emma (Support): noted — asked customer to pause exports and confirmed they'd accept a temporary preservation initiated by us. customer wants ETA for when we can guarantee an archival copy that they can hand to legal.

sophia (Infra): preliminary: migration-tool logs show it updated account default retention in the control plane only (did not write into object metadata). I'm not seeing a bulk TTL rewrite, so likely decrypt->export parsing bug. will open infra ticket and include snippet of migration changelog.

ben (SRE): found worker logs: `export-worker-7f9` shows repeated `kms:Decrypt failed` for obj_9a8b7c then `export-fallback: tombstone-row-emitted` at 02:07:11Z. attaching log lines to ticket.

raj (Legal): please send me the exact timestamps and the CSV rows for the affected objs. I'll draft a preservation confirmation email for the customer and coordinate with them on legal hold language.

emma (Support): attaching CSV rows + log snippets to the Jira ticket I filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-7219. I'm also asking the customer if they want us to run a re-export with `include_deleted=true` as a stop-gap.

ben (SRE): temporary mitigation: we can re-run the export with `include_deleted=true` and `decrypt_with_alias=alias/redwood-master` (admin path) to avoid the rotated alias until KMS key issue resolved. requires approvals and will generate a support-facing export (not public). I can run if infra signs off.

sophia (Infra): approved — I'll provide the admin alias and a short window to run the re-export. also starting a separate KMS postmortem for the rotation job.

emma (Support): thanks team. I'll keep the customer updated: initial ETA for re-export + preservation steps in 2 hours. assigning follow-ups in the Jira. :handshake:
